title: The gas station restroom and the police
summary: Driving with her cousin's family, she was refused a restroom at a Southern gas station. The owner called the police, and she told both off, saying she had asked for a restroom, not a certain color.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand

blocks.x: There was one story you told Stanley and I don't have it right here but I think you'll remember. You were with a young couple with a baby. They were frinds of your's. And you were driving.

Yeah, that was my cousin with his wife and baby. And we went in this gas station and I told them to fill it up, you know, and I wanted to go to the restroom. And he said the restroom is down there. And I went there and I didn't see no restroom. And then I come back and he's got it all fixed, and I said, "Cut the gas off!" And he said, "Well, we don't have a colored restroom". I said, "well where were you sending me?" And

we went down the street and here comes the police. The police said, 'well I see you got California license, but you know we don't cater to people here like they do in California'. I said, 'I don't know what you're talking about'. I said, 'I went in the gas station to have my car serviced and I asked him for the restroom because I've got my little niece here and she wanted to go, and if he didn't have a restroom why didn't he tell me before I put all my gas in there?' He said, 'lady you can't come down here.' I said, 'you don't really know me, Mister.' I said, 'because I go to the head policeman and the Mayor and everybody because I didn't ask him for no certain color toilet. I asked him for a restroom. Now if he didn't have one he should have told me and I would have gone someplace else.' Some where down South there is a restroom. So we had to go to some friend's house to use the toilet. And I told them about it too. He didn't scare me none. So that's the way it is every once in awhile.
